description:
Explain the two private payment rails for agents without an x402 wallet:
(1) ZK rail - deposit once, POST a Groth16 spend proof as the X-Zkapi-Proof header;
(2) session rail - pay one x402 payment for a session key, then query with
X-Zkapi-Session. Returns endpoint URLs, prices, and a minimal example.
name: zkapi_pay_privately_info
